name: Sicilian Kan — Paulsen System
description: The Kan (Paulsen) is the most flexible Sicilian. By delaying ...Nc6, Black keeps maximum options — the dark-squared bishop can fianchetto to g7, the b-pawn can expand with ...b5, and the queen finds an active home on c7. White builds the Maroczy Bind with c4+e4, but Black's elasticity makes it hard to crack. Anand and Svidler have both wielded the Kan at the highest level.

lines.name: Sicilian Kan — Maroczy Bind
lines.description: After 4...a6, Black signals the Kan — no knight committed to c6 yet. White clamps down with the Maroczy Bind 5.c4, and Black develops 5...Nf6 and 6...d6. White continues 6.Nc3 and 7.Bd3; Black fianchettoes with 7...g6 and 8...Bg7 — the elastic Kan setup against the bind, fighting for the d5 and b5 squares.
